newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-FIRST TWO-YEAR T-BILL ISSUE 15 TO 17 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-FIRST TWO-YEAR T-BILL ISSUE 15 TO 17 MLN LATS.

text.p: The state exchequer said on Tuesday that the minimum volume of Latvia's first issue of two-year government Treasury bills will be 15 million lats.

"The first issue (of two-year T-bills) on April 23 will have a minimum volume of 15 million lats and could also be 17 million lats," Dace Brecena, director of the exchequer's internal financial resouces department, told Reuters.
"Smaller volumes would not be liquid," she added.
Depending on money needs, the finance ministry will hold regular weekly or twice-weekly auctions of the two-year paper until the whole volume is sold, Brencena said.
"There is considerable interest for the two-year paper among local banks but interest and auction results are two differnt things," Brencena said.
The ministry has previously told Reuters that it also plans to issue five-year T-bills and she said this may happen at the end of 1997 or the start of 1998.
"The five-year paper is still in the conceptual stage as next year's budget is not yet determined and we do not know the government strategy," Brencena said.
"If they replace external debt with internal debt, there will be good reason for this paper," she said.
Auctions of five year T-bills would not take place more than twice or once a year, she added.
